versions.changelog:
Initial release – scaffolds a production-grade monorepo after a thorough interview

- Runs a mandatory, structured interview to capture all key monorepo requirements before any files are written.
- Supports multiple monorepo tools and package managers (e.g., Turborepo, Nx, pnpm, Bun, Yarn, Rush, uv, Cargo, Go).
- Generates a complete, production-ready monorepo skeleton based on explicit user requirements—not a generic template.
- Includes safety checks to avoid overwriting existing files and improperly initializing git.
- Summarizes the scaffold plan for confirmation and verifies the generated structure post-creation.
- Not for modifying existing monorepos or single standalone app scaffolding.
